---
title: "Data-cut change review"
format: html
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# This template expects `trialdiff_report_data.rds` in the same directory.
# Write it with report_diff(..., output = "trialdiff_report_data.rds")
# after switching the format to "list", or adapt the code below.
```

## Comparison overview

```{r}
report <- readRDS("trialdiff_report_data.rds")
knitr::kable(report$summary, caption = "Comparison summary")
```

## Changes by category

```{r}
reg <- report$register
knitr::kable(table(reg$category_label), caption = "Changes by category")
```

## Modified values

```{r}
modified <- reg[reg$record_type == "modified", , drop = FALSE]
knitr::kable(utils::head(modified, 50))
```

## Downstream impact

```{r}
if (!is.null(report$impacts)) {
  knitr::kable(report$impacts)
}
```

## Items requiring review

```{r}
knitr::kable(report$review_items)
```

> Impact assessment is a review signal derived from user-declared lineage.
> Statistical impact requires rerunning the affected analyses.
